contact.department: Shelby County ReGIS (Regional Geographic Information Systems)

counties.notes: Shelby County (Memphis and suburbs, pop. 934,000) hosts parcel data through ReGIS (Regional Geographic Information Systems), a multi-jurisdictional GIS consortium established by the Shelby County Commission in 2004. The CurrentParcels MapServer at scgis.shelbycountytn.gov exposes 47 confirmed fields. Parcel identifiers: PARCELID (primary display key) and PARID (the CAMA account ID used by the Shelby County Assessor of Property). Owner field is OWNER; OWNER_EXT holds overflow text. Mailing address is split across OWN_ADRNO, ADRPREDIR, ADRSTR, ADRSUF, ADRPOSTDIR for the street component, plus OWN_CITY, OWN_STATE, OWN_ZIP/ZIP4; also available concatenated as OWN_ADDR1/2/3. The MUNI field identifies the municipality -- Memphis, Bartlett, Collierville, Germantown, Lakeland, Millington, or blank for unincorporated Shelby County. That distinction carries real workflow consequences: Memphis's Division of Planning handles incorporated parcels, while the Shelby County Land Use Control Board handles unincorporated ones. Verified 2026-05-15: SMITH returns results from Germantown, Arlington, and unincorporated areas. Last countywide reappraisal was 2025; next scheduled 2029. LEGACY TLS (first documented 2026-06-06, confirmed 2026-06-27): scgis.shelbycountytn.gov requires legacy TLS renegotiation (UNSAFE_LEGACY_RENEGOTIATION). Modern runtimes (Node.js 18+, undici fetch, Python 3.10+ ssl, standard curl) reject the handshake; curl --legacy-server-connect or OpenSSL OP_LEGACY_SERVER_CONNECT succeeds. The endpoint itself is live (353,448 parcels). RESOLVED (2026-07-21): the canonical liveness prober (api/cron/liveness.ts) and the server-side parcel fetch (api/_lib/atlas-resilient-fetch.ts) both use a narrow legacy-TLS path scoped to this hostname alone, so the endpoint probes and fetches correctly; global TLS behavior is unchanged.

counties.notes: Hamilton County (Chattanooga, pop. 375,000) Live_Parcels layer, service name 'Live' indicates real-time feed from the assessor. Service is on mapsdev.hamiltontn.gov (hcwa03 subdirectory). 15 fields confirmed: OBJECTID, PARCEL_TYP, PBA_NUM, GISLINK, OWNERNAME1/2, STNUM, DIRPFX, STNAME, TYPESFX, ADDRESS, MAP, GROUP_, PARCEL. contact.department: City of Johnson City GIS Division (regional parcel layer covering Sullivan County)

counties.notes: Sullivan County, Tennessee (county seat Blountville; Kingsport and Bristol) has no county-run public REST parcel layer with owner names. Its parcels are carried on the City of Johnson City's regional ParcelPublishing/TaxParcels MapServer layer 0 (Tax Parcels), which also holds Washington, Carter, Unicoi and neighbouring counties. Filter with COUNTYNAME='Sullivan County' (78,958 of the layer's 183,538 rows on 2026-10-03); the plain value 'Sullivan' matches nothing. About 313 Sullivan parcels (GISLINK starting 082) carry a NULL or different COUNTYNAME and fall outside this scope, roughly 0.4 percent; COUNTY_ID=82 catches them but admits 314 rows from outside the county, so the name scope stays. The owner is OWNER (with OWNER2); the parcel ID is GISLINK (e.g. 082029B A 01600) with ID as the display form (029B A 016.00), and PARID is NULL for Sullivan rows. ADDRESS stores the street name first and the house number last (BRENTWOOD DR 377), so search on a street word: a number-first LIKE ('%377 BRENTWOOD DR%') returns nothing, and only 647 of 78,737 Sullivan addresses start with a digit, so the free tools' address auto-lookup will miss most Sullivan addresses until they retry number-last. The owner mailing address is MAILADDR with MAILCITY, STATE and ZIP. CARDURL links each parcel to the state's TPAD property card. CORS reflects the request Origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoed back, credentials true); a request without an Origin gets no CORS header. maxRecordCount is 2000. LICENCE: RESTRICTED. The ArcGIS item's licence text reads: "Read access only for all city staff. Delivered products are not to be resold by the purchaser for any reason and may not be reproduced without the written permission of the staff of the Johnson City GIS Division." The item and the REST endpoint are public, but the terms restrict resale and reproduction, so the atlas records only the query URL, stores no copy of the layer beyond the short-lived server cache every live query passes through, and serves this county by live query only; Leo reviewed and accepted that exposure on 2026-10-03. The data was last refreshed in October 2025. Sullivan County's own SULLIVAN service on ArcGIS Online has no owner field, and Tennessee publishes no statewide parcel REST layer. Verified live 2026-10-03: owner SMITH returned rows (first SMITH BETTY TRUSTEE, GISLINK 082029B A 01600, BRENTWOOD DR 377, mailing 377 BRENTWOOD DRIVE KINGSPORT).
